label: Taboola Realize (Taboola Ads)
terms_note: Backstage API credentials are issued per account by the Account Manager or support@taboola.com after submitting a use case.

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (client_id/secret from the Taboola account manager; 12-hour bearer)
sdks: Java Client SDK (developers.taboola.com Backstage API → Java Client SDK)

official_mcp: https://mcp.realize.com/mcp (official Realize MCP, streamable HTTP + OAuth 2.1; Claude Code plugin variant)

auth: 1. "Ask your Taboola Account Manager to provide you with a client_id and client_secret."
2. `POST /backstage/oauth/token` (client credentials flow) → access token valid **12 hours**.
3. `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on each request; missing / expired token → 401.

endpoints.notes: name, branding_text, cpc, daily_cap, daily_ad_delivery_model, spending_limit, spending_limit_model, pricing_model, bid_strategy (MAX_CONVERSIONS / TARGET_CPA / SMART / FIXED), publisher_bid_strategy_modifiers, is_active, start_date, end_date, tracking_code, campaign_group_id
url, title, thumbnail_url, description, cta, is_active
dimensions day / campaign_day_breakdown / site / country / platform; filters campaign, platform, country, site, partner_name (mutually exclusive)

endpoints.call: Targeting: `…/targeting/postal_code`, publishers block, `…/targeting/marketplace_audience`, `custom_audience`, `lookalike`, `contextual`, combined audiences; First-party audiences `POST /{account_id}/
endpoints.notes: type INCLUDE/EXCLUDE, value ids; user identifiers (hashed email / device id)

reference.limits: - Rate limits: not stated on the pages read (TODO(verify)). Free API; Taboola advertising policies apply; credentials are per account (network accounts can act for child advertisers).
mcp_sdk: **Official Realize MCP**: hosted at `https://mcp.realize.com/mcp` (streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 via Taboola SSO) or as a Claude Code plugin — "Analyze campaigns, pull performance reports, and work with the Realize API in natural language".
Official Java client SDK (Backstage API navigation).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Backstage API client_id provided by your Taboola account manager.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The matching client_secret; client-credentials tokens last 12 hours (no refresh token) and are re-requested automatically.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: Taboola account_id (the string id, e.g. demo-advertiser, from list_accounts) used by update_budget and pause_resume, whose paths are /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}.

me.note: GET /backstage/api/1.0/users/current/account: the credentials' own account (id, name, account_id, currency, time_zone_name).

list_accounts.note: GET /backstage/api/1.0/users/current/allowed-accounts: every account the credentials may use. `id` is the string account_id used in paths (raw.id is the numeric id).

list_campaigns.note: GET /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/campaigns/?fetch_level=RAP (recent campaigns, paused included; deleted ones are never returned). `budget` is daily_cap in the account currency (0 = unlimited; applies with daily_ad_delivery_model STRICT); raw.is_active is the on/off switch and raw.spending_limit the total cap. `status` is not a filter.

get_report.note: GET /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/reports/campaign-summary/dimensions/campaign_day_breakdown?start_date&end_date: one row per campaign per day in the account time zone. campaign_id is not applied (this dimension has no campaign filter). Clicks can still change for 48 hours and conversions for 30 days.

update_budget.note: POST /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} {daily_cap}: the daily budget in the account currency (`currency` is ignored); spends money. It applies when daily_ad_delivery_model is STRICT and must stay below spending_limit; 0 means unlimited.

not_offered.pause_resume: Taboola pauses a campaign by updating it with the boolean `is_active` ("To pause (or unpause) a campaign, update the campaign, and set is_active to false (or true)", https://developers.taboola.com/backstage-api/docs/pausing-campaigns); the adapter's map: expression yields strings, not JSON booleans, so it cannot send is_active safely.

evidence: host backstage.taboola.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 301 (redirect), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: update_budget:daily_cap
